welcome.body1: From VIP hotel bookings and private dining to crafting the perfect itinerary for your next dream vacation — we handle a wide variety of requests and inquiries with quiet, obsessive care.
welcome.body2: Whether you need professional planners for family leisure, corporate trips, once-in-a-lifetime events, exclusive yacht charters, distinguished staffing or that one-of-a-kind item for your wander-lusting shopping adventures — RAAR takes every minute stressor off your plate.

hotels-travel.title: Hotels & Travels
hotels-travel.description: From private jets to the world's most storied resorts — we orchestrate every leg of your journey with obsessive care.

real-estate.title: Real Estate
real-estate.description: A villa in the South of France, a riad in Marrakech, or a pied-à-terre in Paris — our property network is global, confidential, and exacting.

dining.title: Dining & Reservations
dining.description: Chef's table access, private dining rooms, and tables where the booking closed months ago. Our network delivers.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.description: Well-being tourism, holistic retreats, responsible food, and interior design for a considered life — curated with trusted partners worldwide.

health.title: Health
health.description: Discreet in-home medical visits, vitamin infusions, physiotherapists and doctors on call — at your service in record time.

luxury-fashion.title: Luxury & Fashion
luxury-fashion.description: Personal shoppers, style consultants, fine jewellery, elusive timepieces and one-of-a-kind artworks — sourced, reserved, delivered.

art.title: Art
art.description: Art advisory and consultancy with the most exclusive artists, galleries and fairs — plus private viewings your dealer can't arrange.

beauty.title: Beauty
beauty.description: Make-up artists, coiffeurs, aesthetic doctors for botox or bespoke injectables — the best, at the pace your life demands.

staffing.title: Staffing
staffing.description: Nannies, private chefs, chauffeurs, housekeepers, security — meticulously trained professionals available around the clock.

polo-racing.title: Polo & Racing
polo-racing.description: With partner Capy Mourier, we curate Dubai's finest equestrian days — Meydan races, desert rides, and Al Habtoor polo matches.

itinerary.subtitle: A curated weekend, rendered in three moments. Each season brings a new journey.

arrival.label: Thursday, dusk
arrival.title: The Arrival
arrival.line: The riad. Candles. The Atlas on the skyline.
arrival.description: A private transfer slips you past the ochre walls of the Medina into the quiet of a private riad. Tea on the rooftop as the muezzin calls; a candlelit tagine served in the inner courtyard by a chef who's cooked for three kings.

desert.label: Friday, first light
desert.title: The Desert
desert.line: Breakfast at first light in the Agafay.
desert.description: A Defender at 5am, the Atlas pink on the horizon. Berber coffee and warm khobz at a hilltop camp of kilims and low copper tables. A horse ride through the stone desert — or the quiet of a private hot air balloon at sunrise.

medina.label: Saturday, after dark
medina.title: The Medina
medina.line: A private gallery, then jazz long after midnight.
medina.description: Late lunch in the gardens of La Mamounia. A trusted guide opens the souks before the crowds; a private viewing at Voice Gallery of a painter you'll hear about next year. Dinner at Dar Yacout, then Le Salama until the music stops.

itinerary.outro: — or tell us where you'd like to disappear to, and we'll build the rest.
